officialText:
The master fire suppression piping contractor shall conduct his or her business to provide direct and continuing supervision in accordance with the provisions of this code.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
